payload.title: growthAnalysis always fails with INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR (a flat result returned as a nested type) and the growth simulator's feed lookup never works (wrong SQL placeholders swallowed into an empty cache)
payload.rule_violated: A resolver returns the type its field declares, and a query that fails is not cached as an empty answer
payload.notes: Found by the 2026-10-26 Feeding production E2E audit (report: docs/reviews/claude/2026-10-27-feeding-audit-report.md).
narrative: Live: 'Cannot return null for non-nullable field GrowthAnalysisResponse.batchCode'; the simulator's 91 projection rows carry feedCode null and feedRequirements [] while the batch has an active feed assignment. Fix: map the handler result, bind $(i+2) (or = ANY($2::uuid[])), stop caching the failure, add specs (none cover FeedSelectorService or GrowthSimulatorService).
